_comment: Follow-up handoff after Codex Review 01 found residual fake-success controls on visible fixture workflow screens. This must complete before Copilot deploys the W4 SIT E2E vertical slice.
title: Close residual fake-success controls found by Codex Review 01
lane: Claude Code - frontend visible-control cleanup and local verification
objective: Fix the remaining visible fixture workflow controls that still show success toasts without backend persistence. The prior pass wired Company/User/AP/AR, but Codex Review 01 found residual Review Scan / Review Mapping / Processing demo actions still claiming success. Make those controls honestly deferred/disabled or wire them if a real backend exists.

do_not_touch: src/frontend/index.html parity lane unless explicitly needed for local validation
hard_boundary.implementation_rule: This is a blocker fix, not a memo-only review. Edit the repo so visible controls do not fake success.

known_findings_to_fix.issue: Review Scan approve button still calls showToast('Approve แล้ว ✓','ok') on fixture data.
known_findings_to_fix.required_fix: Disable/defer it with clear wording, or wire a real backend approval endpoint if one exists.

known_findings_to_fix.issue: Review Scan approve-all button still calls showToast('Approve ทั้งหมดแล้ว ✓','ok') on fixture data.
known_findings_to_fix.required_fix: Disable/defer it with clear wording, or wire a real backend bulk-approval endpoint if one exists.

known_findings_to_fix.issue: Review Mapping confirm button still calls showToast('Confirm Mapping แล้ว ✓','ok') on fixture data.
known_findings_to_fix.required_fix: Disable/defer it with clear wording, or wire a real backend confirm endpoint if one exists.

known_findings_to_fix.issue: Processing retry modal still says it is retrying with an ok toast while the screen is fixture/demo data.
known_findings_to_fix.required_fix: Make it warning/deferred or wire a real retry task endpoint.

what_to_do: 1. Re-run a grep/static audit for `showToast` calls that pass `ok` on visible fixture/demo screens.
2. Classify every remaining `ok` toast as real backend success, auth/session success, export/template API success, or fake success.
3. For fake-success controls, change the UI to disabled/deferred/warn wording or wire a real backend call if the route already exists.
4. Keep real API-backed success toasts intact for Company/User/AP/AR/Export/Template/Configurator actions.
5. Add or update one focused E2E/static test that catches the Review Scan / Review Mapping residual fake-success regression.
6. Update W4 task/plan wording only if the status changes; do not claim live SIT proof.
7. Produce a follow-up completion report for Codex review.
acceptance_criteria: No visible fixture/demo workflow control still claims approve/confirm/retry success without backend persistence.
A static grep summary of remaining `showToast(..., ok)` calls is included and each remaining ok toast is justified as real API/auth success or explicitly non-blocking.
Company/User/AP/AR/Export/Configurator wired flows are not regressed.
At least one focused test or static check is added/updated for the residual fake-success class.
`npm run verify:w4-html` may still fail only because of `index.html` parity, which remains Copilot's lane; do not silently ignore any new failure.
Completion report clearly states whether Copilot may proceed after Codex review.
recommended_checks: Select-String or rg for `showToast` with `ok` in `src/frontend/main-ux-ui.html`
npm run verify:w4-html (record result; index parity may still be expected failure until Copilot)
Focused Playwright/static test for review/mapping deferred controls
Existing W4 export/admin CRUD tests if feasible
final_instruction_to_claude: Close the blocker in code, not just docs. Do not deploy. Leave index.html parity/live SIT proof to Copilot.
